        private function qClaimAllPackagesHandler(r:GetPackageListResponse):void
        {
            var ids:Array;
            var pkg:PackageBean;
            var i:int;
            var handler:Function;
            var claimPkg:Function;
            if (r.ok != CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
            {
                this.cmdLogMsg(("Error received: " + r.errorMsg));
                return;
            };
            if (((r.packagesArray == null) || (r.packagesArray.length == 0)))
            {
                this.cmdLogMsg("Received empty package list from server.");
                return;
            };
            ids = new Array();
            for each (pkg in r.packagesArray)
            {
                if (pkg.status == ObjConstants.PACKAGE_STATUS_AVAIBLE)
                {
                    ids.push(pkg.id);
                };
            };
            if (ids.length == 0)
            {
                this.cmdLogMsg("No available packages received from server. Nothing to claim.");
                return;
            };
            this.cmdLogMsg((("Attempting to claim " + ids.length) + " packages..."));
            i = 0;
            handler = function (_arg_1:GetPackageResponse):void
            {
                i++;
                if (_arg_1.ok == GetPackageResponse.ERROR_PACKAGE_EXPIRED)
                {
                    cmdLogMsg(((((("ERROR while claiming package " + i) + " with id: ") + ids[i]) + ": ") + _arg_1.errorMsg));
                }
                else
                {
                    if (_arg_1.ok == GetPackageResponse.ERROR_PACKAGE_NOT_EXISTS)
                    {
                        cmdLogMsg(((((("ERROR while claiming package " + i) + " with id: ") + ids[i]) + ": ") + _arg_1.errorMsg));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (_arg_1.ok == GetPackageResponse.ERROR_REQUIRMENT_NOT_MET)
                        {
                            cmdLogMsg(((((("ERROR while claiming package " + i) + " with id: ") + ids[i]) + ": ") + _arg_1.errorMsg));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            cmdLogMsg(((("Successfully claimed package " + i) + " with id: ") + ids[i]));
                        };
                    };
                };
                if (i < ids.length)
                {
                    Utils.callLater(50, claimPkg);
                }
                else
                {
                    cmdLogMsg((("Completed attempting to claim " + ids.length) + " packages."));
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getCommonCommands().getPackageNumber(MainScreen.getInstance().setBoxNum);
                };
            };
            claimPkg = function (_arg_1:TimerEvent=null):void
            {
                ActionFactory.getInstance().getCommonCommands().getPackage(ids[i], "", handler);
            };
            Utils.callLater(50, claimPkg);
        }

        public static function getBarrackArray(_arg_1:CityState, _arg_2:int):Array
        {
            var _local_4:BuildingBean;
            var _local_3:Array = new Array();
            for each (_local_4 in _arg_1.castle.buildingsArray)
            {
                if (_local_4.typeId == BuildingConstants.TYPE_BARRACK)
                {
                    if (_local_4.level >= _arg_2)
                    {
                        _local_3[_local_3.length] = _local_4;
                    };
                };
            };
            return (_local_3);
        }

        private static function getMaxAmountPopulationOnly(_arg_1:CityState, _arg_2:int):Number
        {
            staticInit();
            var _local_3:Number = 0;
            var _local_4:TroopInfo = m_troopinfo[String(_arg_2)];
            var _local_5:int = (_arg_1.castle.resource.curPopulation - _arg_1.castle.resource.workPeople);
            if (_local_4.pop == 0)
            {
                _local_3 = -1;
            }
            else
            {
                if (_local_5 > 0)
                {
                    _local_3 = (_local_5 / _local_4.pop);
                }
                else
                {
                    _local_3 = 0;
                };
            };
            return (_local_3);
        }

        private static function cityHasEnoughResearch(_arg_1:CityState, _arg_2:int):Boolean
        {
            var _local_6:IdLevel;
            staticInit();
            var _local_3:Boolean = true;
            var _local_4:TroopInfo = m_troopinfo[String(_arg_2)];
            var _local_5:Object = _arg_1.getTechLevels();
            for each (_local_6 in _local_4.tech)
            {

                {
                    _local_3 = false;
                    break;
                };
            };
            return (_local_3);
        }

        private static function staticInit():void
        {
            if (m_troopinfo == null)
            {

            };
        }

        private static function getValidBarrackId(_arg_1:CityState, _arg_2:int, _arg_3:int, _arg_4:Boolean):int
        {
            var _local_6:BuildingBean;
            staticInit();
            var _local_5:Array = getBarrackArray(_arg_1, m_troopinfo[String(_arg_2)].level);

                    };
                };
            };

        }

        {
            this.openPopUp(_arg_1);
        }

        private function openPopUp(_arg_1:popUpWinShowEvent):void
        {
            var _local_2:* = null;
            if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALERT_WIN)
            {
                if ((_local_2 = new AlertWin()).isPopUp)
                {
                    PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                }
                else
                {
                    PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                };
                _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.msg, _arg_1.callBack, _arg_1.yesBtnName, _arg_1.noBtnName, _arg_1.args, _arg_1.winTitle, this.closePopUp);
            }
            else
            {
                if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ARMY_DETAILS_WIN)
                {
                    if ((_local_2 = new ArmyDetailsWin()).isPopUp)
                    {
                        PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, false);
                    };
                    _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.args, this.closePopUp);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.TRAINING_FIELD_WIN)
                    {
                        if ((_local_2 = new NewArmyWin()).isPopUp)
                        {
                            PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, false);
                        };
                        _local_2.updateInfo(this.closePopUp);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.VIEW_ITEM_INFO_WIN)
                        {
                            if ((_local_2 = new ItemViewWin()).isPopUp)
                            {
                                PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, false);
                            };
                            _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.args, this.closePopUp);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.BUY_ITEM_WIN)
                            {
                                if ((_local_2 = new BuyItemWin()).isPopUp)
                                {
                                    PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                };
                                _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.args, this.closePopUp);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.HERO_MANAGEMENT_WIN)
                                {
                                    if ((_local_2 = new HeroViewWin()).isPopUp)
                                    {
                                        PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                    };
                                    _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.args, this.closePopUp);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.HERO_DESC_WIN)
                                    {
                                        if ((_local_2 = new HistHeroDescWin()).isPopUp)
                                        {
                                            PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                        };
                                        _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.objParam, this.closePopUp);
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.HERO_APPLY_ITEM_WIN)
                                        {
                                            if ((_local_2 = new ChooseHeroItemWin()).isPopUp)
                                            {
                                                PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                            }
                                            else
                                            {
                                                PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                            };
                                            _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.winTitle, _arg_1.objParam, this.closePopUp);
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_INFO_WIN)
                                            {
                                                if ((_local_2 = new AllianceInfoWin()).isPopUp)
                                                {
                                                    PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                };
                                                _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.objParam, this.closePopUp);
                                            }
                                            else
                                            {
                                                if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_MEMBER_INFO)
                                                {
                                                    if ((_local_2 = new MemberInfoWin()).isPopUp)
                                                    {
                                                        PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                    }
                                                    else
                                                    {
                                                        PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                    };
                                                    _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.objParam, this.closePopUp);
                                                }
                                                else
                                                {
                                                    if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_EXPEL_MEMBER)
                                                    {
                                                        if ((_local_2 = new ExpelMemberWin()).isPopUp)
                                                        {
                                                            PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                        }
                                                        else
                                                        {
                                                            PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                        };
                                                        _local_2.updateInfo(_arg_1.membersArray, this.closePopUp);
                                                    }
                                                    else
                                                    {
                                                        if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_EDIT_INTRO)
                                                        {
                                                            if ((_local_2 = new EditIntroductionWin()).isPopUp)
                                                            {
                                                                PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                            }
                                                            else
                                                            {
                                                                PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                            };
                                                            _local_2.updateInfo(this.closePopUp);
                                                        }
                                                        else
                                                        {
                                                            if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_INVITE_MEMBER)
                                                            {
                                                                if ((_local_2 = new AllianceInviteMemberWin()).isPopUp)
                                                                {
                                                                    PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                                }
                                                                else
                                                                {
                                                                    PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                                };
                                                                _local_2.updateInfo(this.closePopUp);
                                                            }
                                                            else
                                                            {
                                                                if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_PENDING_APPLICATIONS)
                                                                {
                                                                    if ((_local_2 = new CheckApplyWin()).isPopUp)
                                                                    {
                                                                        PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                                    }
                                                                    else
                                                                    {
                                                                        PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                                    };
                                                                    _local_2.updateInfo(this.closePopUp);
                                                                }
                                                                else
                                                                {
                                                                    if (_arg_1.popUpType == popUpWinShowEvent.ALLIANCE_CHANGE_HOST)
                                                                    {
                                                                        if ((_local_2 = new ChangeCovenanterWin()).isPopUp)
                                                                        {
                                                                            PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
                                                                        }
                                                                        else
                                                                        {
                                                                            PopUpManager.addPopUp(_local_2, this.parent, true);
                                                                        };
                                                                        _local_2.updateInfo(this.closePopUp);
                                                                    };
                                                                };
                                                            };
                                                        };
                                                    };
                                                };
                                            };
                                        };
                                    };
                                };
                            };
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
            PopUpManager.centerPopUp(_local_2);
            PopUpManager.bringToFront(_local_2);
            _local_2.addEventListener(popUpWinShowEvent.POP_UP_WIN_SHOW, this.newPopUpWin);
            _local_2.setFocus();
        }

        private function closePopUp(_arg_1:*=null):void
        {
            _arg_1.removeEventListener(popUpWinShowEvent.POP_UP_WIN_SHOW, this.newPopUpWin);
            PopUpManager.removePopUp((_arg_1 as IFlexDisplayObject));
            _arg_1 = null;
        }


    }

        private function close():void

            {

            }

            {
                if (this.armyType == "friendly")
                {
                    ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().removeEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.SERVER_FRIEND_ARMYS_UPDATE, this.onArmyUpdates);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (this.armyType == "enemy")
                    {
                        ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().removeEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.SERVER_ENEMY_ARMYS_UPDATE, this.onArmyUpdates);
                    };
                };
            };
            ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().removeEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.SERVER_ITEM_UPDATE, this.onItemUpdate);
            if (this.updateTimeTimer != null)
            {
                this.updateTimeTimer.stop();
                this.updateTimeTimer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, this.updateReachTime);
                this.updateTimeTimer = null;
            };
            if (this.itemSelectInfo != null)
            {
                this.itemSelectInfo.removeAll();
                this.itemSelectInfo = null;
            };
            if (this.troopData != null)
            {
                this.troopData.removeAll();
                this.troopData = null;
            };
            if (this.resoData != null)
            {
                this.resoData.removeAll();
                this.resoData = null;
            };
            this.useFunc = null;
            this.army = null;
            this.armyType = null;
            this.closeFunc.apply(null, [this]);
        }

        internal function onSaveAll(_arg_1:Object=null):void
        {
            var _local_2:CityState;
            if (_arg_1 == null)
            {
                this.queueJobs.logMsg("Save all goals and scripts and various internal data");
                CityManager.cleanUpAndFlushAllTimingLists();
                this.queueJobs.dispatchEvent(new Event(SAVEALLEVENT));
            }
            else
            {
                for each (_local_2 in MainScreen.getCities())
                {
                    this.onSaveGoals(_local_2.castleId, true);
                    this.onSaveScript(_local_2.castleId, true);
                };
            };
        }

        private function onSaveToFile(source:TextArea):void
        {
            var saveFile:FileReference;
            var cP:CityPanelBean;
            var completedHandler:Function;
            var canceledHandler:Function;
            var errorHandler:Function;
            if (((source == null) || (source.text == "")))
            {
                return;
            };
            var outputText:String = source.text.replace(/\r\n?|\n/g, "\r\n");
            var outputFileName:String = "";
            saveFile = null;
            cP = this._cityPanelBean;
            if (source.id == this._scriptTxt.id)
            {
                if (((!(cP.lastSavedScriptFileName == null)) && (!(cP.lastSavedScriptFileName == ""))))
                {
                    outputFileName = cP.lastSavedScriptFileName;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (((!(cP.lastLoadedScriptFileName == null)) && (!(cP.lastLoadedScriptFileName == ""))))
                    {
                        outputFileName = cP.lastLoadedScriptFileName;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        outputFileName = (((this.city.player.playerInfo.userName + "_") + this.city.castle.name) + "_script.txt");
                    };
                };
            };
            if (source.id == this._goalsTxt.id)
            {
                if (((!(cP.lastSavedGoalsFileName == null)) && (!(cP.lastSavedGoalsFileName == ""))))
                {
                    outputFileName = cP.lastSavedGoalsFileName;
                }
                else
                {
                    if (((!(cP.lastLoadedGoalsFileName == null)) && (!(cP.lastLoadedGoalsFileName == ""))))
                    {
                        outputFileName = cP.lastLoadedGoalsFileName;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        outputFileName = (((this.city.player.playerInfo.userName + "_") + this.city.castle.name) + "_goals.txt");
                    };
                };
            };
            saveFile = new FileReference();
            completedHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completedHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                if (source.id == _scriptTxt.id)
                {
                    cP.lastSavedScriptFileName = saveFile.name;
                };
                if (source.id == _goalsTxt.id)
                {
                    cP.lastSavedGoalsFileName = saveFile.name;
                };
                city.cityManager.logMsg((('The file "' + saveFile.name) + '" has been saved successfully.'));
                saveFile = null;
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("The file has been saved successfully. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            canceledHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completedHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                saveFile = null;
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("The file save has been canceled. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            errorHandler = function (_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completedHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                saveFile = null;
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("An error occured while saving the file. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            try
            {
                saveFile.addEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completedHandler);
                saveFile.addEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.addEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                saveFile.save(outputText, outputFileName);
            }
            catch(error:Error)
            {
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(error);
                };
            };
        }

        private function onLoadFromFile(target:TextArea):void
        {
            var loadFile:FileReference;
            var cP:CityPanelBean;
            var selectedHandler:Function;
            var canceledHandler:Function;
            var completeHandler:Function;
            var errorHandler:Function;
            loadFile = null;
            cP = this._cityPanelBean;
            selectedHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.SELECT, selectedHandler);
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                loadFile.addEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completeHandler);
                loadFile.addEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                loadFile.load();
            };
            canceledHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.SELECT, selectedHandler);
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("The file load has been canceled. " + _arg_1));
                };
                loadFile = null;
            };
            completeHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completeHandler);
                loadFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                var _local_2:String = loadFile.data.readUTFBytes(loadFile.data.bytesAvailable).replace(/\r\n?|\n/g, "\n");
                if (target.id == _scriptTxt.id)
                {
                    cP.scriptTxt = _local_2;
                    cP.lastLoadedScriptFileName = loadFile.name;
                };
                if (target.id == _goalsTxt.id)
                {
                    cP.goalsTxt = _local_2;
                    cP.lastLoadedGoalsFileName = loadFile.name;
                };
                city.cityManager.logMsg((((('The contents of file "' + loadFile.name) + '" was loaded successfully to the ') + ((target.id == _scriptTxt.id) ? "Script" : ((target.id == _goalsTxt.id) ? "Goals" : ""))) + " window."));
                loadFile = null;
            };
            errorHandler = function (_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void
            {
                loadFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completeHandler);
                loadFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("Error loading file : " + _arg_1.text));
                };
                city.cityManager.logMsg(("An error occured while loading the file. " + _arg_1), "#FF9933");
                loadFile = null;
            };
            loadFile = new FileReference();
            loadFile.addEventListener(Event.SELECT, selectedHandler);
            loadFile.addEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
            loadFile.browse([new FileFilter("Text File", "*.txt;*.text")]);
        }

        private function onRenameBtn():void
        {
            this._inputNewCastleName.visible = true;
            this._inputNewCastleName.text = this._castleBean.name;
            this._inputNewCastleName.setFocus();
            Utils.callLater(100, function ():void

        private function initCities():void
        {

            var firstCastleId:int = (this.currentPlayer.castlesArray.getItemAt(0) as CastleBean).id;

            {

                {

                    {

                            };
                            (cities[i] as CityState)._setCastleBean();
                            break;
                        };
                        ii = (ii + 1);
                    };
                    if (!found)
                    {
                        if (castle.id != firstCastleId)

                            newCity = new CityState(int(castle.id));

                            newCity = new CityState(int(castle.id), false);
                        };

                        cPanelBean = new CityPanelBean(int(castle.id), (((castle.name.length < 4) ? castle.name : castle.name.substring(0, 3)) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(castle.fieldId)));
                        this._cityPanelBeansArray.addChild(cPanelBean);
                        this.initCityScript(newCity);
                        cPanelBean.onLoadGoals();
                        cPanelBean.onLoadScript(null, 5000);
                    };
                    i = (i + 1);
                };
                this.removeStaleCityObjects();
                if (!this._cityPanel.isInitialized)
                {
                    this._cityPanel.init();
                };
                Utils.callLater(50, this.doCityTabLabels);
                Utils.callLater(100, this.doCityTabColors);

        private function onSaveToFile():void
        {
            var saveFile:FileReference;
            var canceledHandler:Function;
            var errorHandler:Function;
            if (((this.snippetsTextArea == null) || (this.snippetsTextArea.text == "")))
            {
                return;
            };
            var outputText:String = this.snippetsTextArea.text.replace(/\r\n?|\n/g, "\r\n");
            var outputFileName:String = "";
            saveFile = null;
            if (((!(this.lastSavedFileName == null)) && (!(this.lastSavedFileName == ""))))
            {
                outputFileName = this.lastSavedFileName;
            }
            else
            {
                if (((!(this.LastLoadedFileName == null)) && (!(this.LastLoadedFileName == ""))))
                {
                    outputFileName = this.LastLoadedFileName;
                }
                else
                {
                    outputFileName = (MainScreen.getPlayer().playerInfo.userName + "_snippets.txt");
                };
            };
            saveFile = new FileReference();
            var completedHandler:Function = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, removeEventListener);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                lastSavedFileName = saveFile.name;
                status.text = (('The file "' + saveFile.name) + '" has been saved successfully.');
                saveFile = null;

                {
                    trace(("The Snippets file has been saved successfully. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            canceledHandler = function (_arg_1:Event):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, removeEventListener);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                saveFile = null;
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("The Snippets file save has been canceled. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            errorHandler = function (_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void
            {
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, removeEventListener);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);
                saveFile.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, errorHandler);
                saveFile = null;
                if (Version.isTraceOn())
                {
                    trace(("An error occured while saving the Snippets file. " + _arg_1));
                };
            };
            try
            {
                saveFile.addEventListener(Event.COMPLETE, completedHandler);
                saveFile.addEventListener(Event.CANCEL, canceledHandler);

            };
        }

            if (this.authenticated)
            {
                this.reconnectTimer.stop();
                return;
            };
            if (!this.reconnectTimer.running)
            {
                Utils.callLater(5000, this.reconnectTimer.start);
            };
            var time:Number = new Date().getTime();
            if (this.socket.connected)
            {
                if (time < (this.lastConnectionTime + ((15 * 60) * 1000)))
                {
                    return;
                };
                this.logMsg("Closing existing connection...");
                try
                {
                    this.socket.close();
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                };
                if (((this.reconnectTimer.delay < ((15 * 60) * 1000)) && (this.reconnectTimer.running)))
                {
                    return;
                };
            };
            var MAXQUICKATTEMPTS:int = 3;
            this.connect();
            this.connectAttempts++;
            this.lastConnectionTime = time;
            if (this.connectAttempts > MAXQUICKATTEMPTS)
            {
                if ((this.connectAttempts % MAXQUICKATTEMPTS) == 1)
                {
                    if (this.reconnectTimer.delay < ((5 * 60) * 1000))
                    {
                        this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((5 * 60) * 1000), ((8 * 60) * 1000));
                        this.logMsg(("  ...next attempt will be in " + Utils.formatTime((this.reconnectTimer.delay / 1000))));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (this.reconnectTimer.delay < ((30 * 60) * 1000))
                        {
                            this.reconnectTimer.delay = (this.reconnectTimer.delay * (1 + Math.random()));
                            this.logMsg(("  ...next attempt will be in " + Utils.formatTime((this.reconnectTimer.delay / 1000))));
                        };
                    };
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (this.reconnectTimer.delay < ((2 * 60) * 1000))
                {
                    this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((2 * 60) * 1000), ((5 * 60) * 1000));
                };
                if (this.reconnectTimer.delay > ((15 * 60) * 1000))
                {
                    this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((15 * 60) * 1000), ((20 * 60) * 1000));
                };
                this.logMsg(("  ...next attempt will be in " + Utils.formatTime((this.reconnectTimer.delay / 1000))));
            };
        }

        public function init():void
        {
            if (this.initialized)
            {
                return;
            };
            this.initialized = true;
            this.socket = new ProxySocket();
            this.sendTimer = new Timer(50);
            this.sendTimer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, this.onSendTimer);
            this.reconnectTimer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, this.reconnectHandler);
            this.connectionCheckTimer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, this.onConnectionCheckTimer);
            this.connectionCheckTimer.start();
            addEventListener(GameClientEvent.ON_EXTENSION_RESPONSE, this.onExtensionResponseHandle);
            ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().addEventListener(ResponseDispatcher.SERVER_LOGIN_RESPONSE, this.onLogin);
            this.socket.addEventListener(Event.CONNECT, this.connectHandler);
            this.socket.addEventListener(Event.CLOSE, this.closeHandler);
            this.socket.addEventListener(ProgressEvent.SOCKET_DATA, this.socketDataHandler);
            this.socket.addEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, this.ioErrorHandler);
            this.socket.addEventListener(SecurityErrorEvent.SECURITY_ERROR, this.securityErrorHandler);
            this.connect();
            Utils.callLater((60 * 1000), this.reconnectTimer.start);
        }

        private function securityErrorHandler(_arg_1:SecurityErrorEvent):void
        {
            this.authenticated = false;
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_ERROR));
        }

        private function onExtensionResponseHandle(_arg_1:GameClientEvent):void
        {
            ResponseDispatcher.getInstance().dispatch(_arg_1.cmd, _arg_1.data);
        }

        private function onConnectionCheckTimer(_arg_1:TimerEvent=null):void
        {
            if (this.paused)
            {
                return;
            };
            if ((Utils.getServerTime() - this.lastPackageTime) < this.connectionCheckTimer.delay)
            {
                return;
            };
            this.logMsg(" *** BAD CONNECTION STATE: No package received recently ***");
            this.disconnect();
            this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(10000, 30000);
            this.reconnectTimer.start();
            this.lastPackageTime = Utils.getServerTime();
        }

        public function disconnect():void
        {
            MainScreen.getInstance().disableLogoutButton();
            try
            {
                this.socket.close();
            }
            catch(e:Error)
            {
            };
            this.authenticated = false;
            this.packageSize = -1;
            this.lastPackageTime = Utils.getServerTime();
        }

        private function logMsg(_arg_1:String):void
        {
            MainScreen.getInstance().logMsg(_arg_1);
        }

        private function closeHandler(evt:Event):void
        {
            this.authenticated = false;
            if (this.paused)
            {
                this.logMsg("Disconnected from server");
            }
            else
            {
                if (!this.hasReceivedData)
                {
                    if (this.reconnectTimer.delay < ((5 * 60) * 1000))
                    {
                        this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((5 * 60) * 1000), ((6 * 60) * 1000));
                    };
                };
                this.reconnectTimer.delay = (this.reconnectTimer.delay + CityManager.getMatime());
                this.logMsg(("Disconnected from server, retry in " + Utils.formatTime((this.reconnectTimer.delay / 1000))));
                this.reconnectTimer.start();
            };
            try
            {
                this.disconnect();
            }
            catch(e:IOError)
            {
            };
            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(ResponseDispatcher.SERVER_CONNECTION_LOST));
        }

        private function directSendMessage(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:Object):void
        {
            var _local_3:ByteArray;
            if (this.socket.connected)
            {
                if (traceOn)
                {
                    trace(((((Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime()) + " - Sending: ") + _arg_1) + " ") + _arg_2.toString()));
                };
                _local_3 = new ByteArray();
                _local_3.writeObject({
                    "cmd":_arg_1,
                    "data":_arg_2
                });
                this.socket.writeInt(_local_3.length);
                this.socket.writeBytes(_local_3);
                this.socket.flush();
            };
        }

        private function socketDataHandler(evt:ProgressEvent):void
        {
            var nBytes:int;
            var amfObj:Object;
            this.hasReceivedData = true;
            if (this.busy)
            {
                return;
            };
            this.busy = true;
            try
            {
                while (this.socket.bytesAvailable > 0)
                {
                    if (this.packageSize == -1)
                    {
                        if (this.socket.bytesAvailable < 4)
                        {
                            this.busy = false;
                            return;
                        };
                        try
                        {
                            this.packageSize = this.socket.readInt();
                        }
                        catch(e1:Error)
                        {
                            this.logMsg("An error occurred while talking to the server (read package size). Reconnect...");
                            reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((8 * 60) * 1000), ((10 * 60) * 1000));
                            closeHandler(null);
                            return;
                        };
                        if (((this.packageSize < 0) || (this.packageSize > MAX_PACKAGE_SIZE)))
                        {
                            this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((8 * 60) * 1000), ((10 * 60) * 1000));
                            this.logMsg((("An error occurred while talking to the server (invalid package size " + this.packageSize) + "). Reconnect..."));
                            this.closeHandler(null);
                            return;
                        };
                        this.buffer = new ByteArray();
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        nBytes = Math.min(this.socket.bytesAvailable, (this.packageSize - this.buffer.length));
                        try
                        {
                            this.socket.readBytes(this.buffer, this.buffer.length, nBytes);
                        }
                        catch(e2:Error)
                        {
                            reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((8 * 60) * 1000), ((10 * 60) * 1000));
                            this.logMsg("An error occurred while talking to the server (read object). Reconnect...");
                            closeHandler(null);
                            return;
                        };
                        if (this.buffer.length == this.packageSize)
                        {
                            if (traceOn)
                            {
                                trace((Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime()) + " - Package read"));
                            };
                            try
                            {
                                amfObj = this.buffer.readObject();
                            }
                            catch(e3:Error)
                            {
                                reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((8 * 60) * 1000), ((10 * 60) * 1000));
                                this.logMsg("An error occurred while talking to the server (convert object). Reconnect...");
                                closeHandler(null);
                                return;
                            };
                            if ((((!(amfObj)) || (amfObj.cmd == undefined)) || (amfObj.data == undefined)))
                            {
                                this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((8 * 60) * 1000), ((10 * 60) * 1000));
                                this.logMsg("An error occurred while talking to the server (invalid object). Reconnect...");
                                this.closeHandler(null);
                                return;
                            };
                            if (traceOn)
                            {
                                trace(((((Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime()) + " - Read: ") + amfObj.cmd) + " ") + amfObj.data.toString()));
                            };
                            this.packageSize = -1;
                            dispatchEvent(new GameClientEvent(GameClientEvent.ON_EXTENSION_RESPONSE, amfObj));
                            this.lastPackageTime = Utils.getServerTime();
                        };
                    };
                };
            }
            catch(e4:Error)
            {
                this.logMsg("Unknown error reading data from server");
                if (traceOn)
                {
                    trace(((Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime()) + " - ") + e4.getStackTrace()));
                };
            };
            this.busy = false;
        }

        private function onLogin(_arg_1:LoginResponse):void
        {
            if (traceOn)
            {
                trace((Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime()) + " - receive login response"));
            };
            this.loginAttempts++;
            if (_arg_1.player == null)
            {
                switch (_arg_1.ok)
                {
                    case LoginResponse.LOGIN_RESULT_NEED_CREATE_PLAYER:
                        this.logMsg("You have not logged in to this server ever before. Use the real game client to setup your name and other details, then use this client to connect.");
                        return;
                    case LoginResponse.LOGIN_RESULT_SERVER_FULL:
                        this.logMsg("Server full, please try again later");
                        return;
                    case LoginResponse.LOGIN_RESULT_ERROR_USERNAME:
                        if (this.loginAttempts > 10)
                        {
                            this.logMsg("Invalid user name or password, please try again");
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(((this.loginAttempts * 60) * 1000), (((this.loginAttempts + 1) * 60) * 1000));
                            this.logMsg(("Invalid password, next retry in " + Utils.formatTime((this.reconnectTimer.delay / 1000))));
                            this.disconnect();
                        };
                        return;
                    default:
                        this.logMsg(("Login failed: " + _arg_1.errorMsg));
                };
                return;
            };
            this.reconnectTimer.delay = Utils.rand(30000, 60000);
            this.authenticated = true;
            this.connectAttempts = 0;
            this.loginAttempts = 0;
        }

        public function getLastCmdInSendQueue():String
        {
            if (this.sendQueue.length == 0)
            {
                return (null);
            };
            return (this.sendQueue[(this.sendQueue.length - 1)].cmd);
        }

        public function sendMessage(_arg_1:String, _arg_2:Object, _arg_3:Function=null):void
        {

                    "cmd":_arg_1,

                if (!this.sendTimer.running)
                {
                    this.sendTimer.start();
                };
            };
        }

        private function ioErrorHandler(_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void

        public function connect():void
        {
            var _local_2:String;
            var _local_3:String;
            if (((LoginHelper.getInstance().isFbLoginType()) && ((!(LoginHelper.getInstance().isFBLoggedIn())) || (!(LoginHelper.getInstance().isEvonyLoggedIn())))))
            {
                this.initFbLogin();
                return;
            };
            this.logMsg("Attempt to connect...");
            this.busy = false;
            this.packageSize = -1;
            this.lastPackageTime = Utils.getServerTime();
            var _local_1:LoginHelper = LoginHelper.getInstance();
            if (_local_1.proxyType != "")
            {
                _local_2 = (((((_local_1.proxyType + "://") + ((_local_1.proxyUn != "") ? (((_local_1.proxyUn + ":") + _local_1.proxyPw) + "@") : "")) + _local_1.proxyHost) + ":") + _local_1.proxyPort);
                _local_3 = this.socket.setProxyInfo(_local_2);
                if (_local_3)
                {
                    this.logMsg(((("Ignoring invalid proxy info: " + _local_2) + "  because: ") + _local_3));
                    _local_1.proxyType = "";
                }
                else
                {
                    this.logMsg(("Using proxy info:  " + _local_2));
                };
            };
            this.socket.connect(LoginHelper.getInstance().serverIP, 443);
            MainScreen.getInstance().enableLogoutButton();
        }

        private function onSendTimer(_arg_1:Object=null):void
        {
            if (!this.authenticated)
            {
                if (this.sendQueue.length > 0)
                {
                    this.sendQueue = new Array();
                };
                if (this.sentQueue.length > 0)
                {
                    this.sentQueue = new Array();
                };
                return;
            };
            if (this.sendQueue.length == 0)
            {
                return;
            };
            if (this.sendQueue.length > 5)
            {
                this.sendTimer.delay = 100;
            }
            else
            {
                if (this.sendQueue.length < 5)
                {
                    this.sendTimer.delay = 50;
                };
            };
            var _local_2:Object = this.sendQueue.shift();
            this.directSendMessage(_local_2.cmd, _local_2.data);
        }

        {

                };
            };
        }

        public function reserveSlot():int
        {
            this.normalQueue.push(this.maxId);
            return (this.maxId++);
        }

        private function onTimer(_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
        {
            if (new Date().getTime() < this.nextActiveTime)
            {
                return;
            };
            if (++this.counter < this.slotSize)
            {
                return;
            };
            this.counter = 0;
            if (emergencyCount < MAXEMERGENCYCOUNT)
            {
                if (this.emergencyQueue.length > 0)
                {
                    this.currentId = this.emergencyQueue[0];
                    this.emergencyQueue.splice(0, 1);
                    emergencyCount++;
                    return;
                };
            };
            emergencyCount = 0;
            if (this.normalQueue.length == 0)
            {
                return;
            };
            this.normalQueueIndex = ((this.normalQueueIndex + 1) % this.normalQueue.length);
            this.currentId = this.normalQueue[this.normalQueueIndex];
        }

        public function canReceive(_arg_1:int):Boolean
        {
            if (this.normalQueue.length <= 1)
            {
                return (true);
            };
            return (_arg_1 == this.currentId);
        }

        public function canSend(_arg_1:int):Boolean
        {
            if (new Date().getTime() < this.nextActiveTime)
            {
                return (false);
            };
            if (this.normalQueue.length <= 1)
            {
                return (true);
            };
            return ((_arg_1 == this.currentId) && (this.counter < this.sendSlotSize));
        }


    }

        private function waitForBuildingQueue(func:Function, args:Array):void
        {
            var handler:Function;
            var waitTimer:Timer;
            this.pleaseStop = false;
            handler = function (_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
            {
                if (pleaseStop)
                {
                    waitTimer.stop();
                    waitTimer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    waitTimer = null;
                    return;
                };
                waitTimer.delay = 1000;
                if (cityManager.isBuildingQueueAvailable())
                {
                    waitTimer.stop();
                    waitTimer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    waitTimer = null;
                    func.apply(this, args);
                };
            };
            waitTimer = new Timer(0);
            waitTimer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
            waitTimer.start();
        }

        private function doMarch(marchType:int, targetId:int, hero:String, troopObj:TroopBean, resources:ResourceBean=null, restTime:String="", warEnsign:Boolean=false, stygandrsBannerOfTheHorde:Boolean=false, argGearing:int=0, callback:Function=null):void
        {
            var selectedHero:HeroBean;
            var armyReady:Boolean;
            var minStamina:int;
            var waitTimeCount:int;
            var handler:Function;
            var timer:Timer;
            if (targetId == this.castle.fieldId)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- destination is the current castle");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            if (targetId == -1)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- Invalid target coordinates.  Specify coords as 'x, y'");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            if (troopObj == null)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- invalid troop");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            this.pleaseStop = false;
            selectedHero = null;
            armyReady = false;
            minStamina = ((marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SEND) ? 1 : ((marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_TRANS) ? 2 : 4));
            waitTimeCount = 0;
            handler = function (e:TimerEvent):void
            {
                var newArmy:NewArmyParam;
                var baseTravelTime:Number;
                var rsSpeedUp:int;
                var heroSpeedUp:Number;
                var travelTime:int;
                var buffsCampFactor:Number;
                var restTimeNumeric:Number;
                if (waitTimeCount == 1)
                {
                    onCmdResult("Checking for available hero and troops...", "");
                };
                waitTimeCount++;
                timer.delay = 1500;
                if (pleaseStop)
                {
                    onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("Script stop, troop deployment cancelled", -9999));
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    return;
                };
                armyReady = isRallySlotAvailable();
                try
                {
                    if (armyReady)
                    {
                        if (((hero.length == 0) || (hero.toLowerCase() == "none")))
                        {
                            armyReady = ((true) && (armyReady));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            selectedHero = getHeroByNameOrKey(hero, minStamina);
                            armyReady = ((!(selectedHero == null)) && (armyReady));
                        };
                    };
                }
                catch(se:ScriptError)
                {
                    onCmdFinshed(se);
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    return;
                };
                if (armyReady)
                {
                    armyReady = ((cityHasEnoughTroops(troopObj)) && (armyReady));
                };
                if (armyReady)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    newArmy = new NewArmyParam();
                    newArmy.missionType = marchType;
                    newArmy.targetPoint = targetId;
                    newArmy.troops = troopObj;
                    newArmy.useFlag = warEnsign;
                    newArmy.useItem = stygandrsBannerOfTheHorde;
                    if (selectedHero != null)
                    {
                        newArmy.heroId = selectedHero.id;
                        if (argGearing > 0)
                        {
                            ActionFactory.getInstance().getEquipmentCommands().WearAllEquipmenttech(selectedHero.id, argGearing);
                            onCmdResult((((" Changing gear to " + ((argGearing == 1) ? "Pol" : ((argGearing == 2) ? "Atk" : "Int"))) + " for ") + selectedHero.name));
                        };
                    };
                    if (resources == null)
                    {
                        resources = new ResourceBean();
                    };
                    newArmy.resource = resources;
                    baseTravelTime = cityManager.getBaseTravelTime(castle.fieldId, targetId, troopObj);
                    rsSpeedUp = ((((!(MainScreen.getCityFromFieldId(targetId) == null)) || ((((Map.getType(targetId) == FieldConstants.TYPE_CASTLE) && (!(Map.getDetailInfo(targetId, 30).allianceName == null))) && (!(player.playerInfo.alliance == null))) && (Map.getDetailInfo(targetId, 30).allianceName == player.playerInfo.alliance))) && ((marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SEND) || (marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_TRANS))) ? _getReliefStationSpeedupFactor() : 1);
                    heroSpeedUp = ((selectedHero != null) ? Utils.getHeroSpeedFactor(selectedHero) : 1);
                    travelTime = int(((baseTravelTime / rsSpeedUp) / heroSpeedUp));
                    buffsCampFactor = 1;
                    restTimeNumeric = 0;
                    if (restTime != "")
                    {
                        buffsCampFactor = cityManager.getCampTimeChangeBuffsFactor();
                        if (((travelTime == 0) && (buffsCampFactor == 1)))
                        {
                            onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("No troop or town has yet to be initialized (research not available)", -9999));
                            return;
                        };
                        if ((restTimeNumeric = _parseRestTime(restTime, travelTime)) > 0)
                        {
                            if (restTimeNumeric > (20 * 3600))
                            {
                                logCmdResponse(("WARNING: Large camp time " + Utils.formatTime(restTimeNumeric)), "", "#FF0000");
                            };
                            if (int((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor)) > ((24 * 60) * 60))
                            {
                                onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError((("Camp time exceeds server limit at " + Utils.formatTime((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor))) + "! Example camp time limits: [normal 24h] [1xFF ~10h:8m:24s] [2xFF ~2h:9m:36s]"), -9999));
                                return;
                            };
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (restTimeNumeric < 0)
                            {
                                logCmdResponse("WARNING: Inappropriate camp time is ignored", "", "#FF0000");
                                if (restTime.charAt(0) == "+")
                                {
                                    logCmdResponse("  make sure you run 'calibrate' recently!", "", "#FF0000");
                                };
                                restTimeNumeric = 0;
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    setCmdResponse(ResponseDispatcher.ARMY_NEW_ARMY, handleCmdResponse);
                    newArmy.restTime = int(restTimeNumeric);
                    onCmdResult(currentAction, (((((((((("- starting march to " + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(targetId)) + " arrival at ") + Utils.getLogTimeStr(((Utils.getServerTime() + campTimeDelta) + ((travelTime + restTimeNumeric) * 1000)))) + ((selectedHero == null) ? "" : (" using " + selectedHero.name))) + " with ") + Utils.troopBeanToMsgString(troopObj)) + " carrying ") + Utils.resourceBeanToString(resources)) + " in ") + Utils.formatTime((travelTime + newArmy.restTime))));
                    if (restTime != "")
                    {
                        Utils.callLater(((restTimeNumeric - newArmy.restTime) * 1000), CityStateCommands.newArmy, [castleId, newArmy]);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        CityStateCommands.newArmy(castleId, newArmy);
                    };
                };
            };
            timer = new Timer(0);
            timer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
            timer.start();
        }

        private function autoStar(tech:String, targetLevel:int, spec1:String=null, spec2:String=null, spec3:String=null, spec4:String=null, spec5:String=null, spec6:String=null, spec7:String=null, spec8:String=null):void
        {
            var techId:int;
            var currentLevel:int;
            var delicateId:String;
            var flawlessId:String;
            var conditions:Array;
            var busy:Boolean;
            var starHandler:Function;
            var handler:Function;
            var timer:Timer;
            var count:int;
            this.currentAction = "autostar";
            if (((targetLevel > 15) || (targetLevel <= 0)))
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(("Invalid gear type: " + tech));
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            techId = GearType.fromString(tech);
            if (techId <= 0)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(("Invalid gear type: " + tech));
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            if (this.cityManager.gears.length == 0)
            {
                this.cityManager.updateGears();
                this.logCmdResponse("Gears not initialized yet, please rerun later");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            currentLevel = this.cityManager.getStarLevel(techId);
            if (currentLevel >= targetLevel)
            {
                this.onCmdResult(("autostar: Nothing to do, star level is already " + currentLevel));
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            delicateId = Items.getItemId("Delicate_gem");
            flawlessId = Items.getItemId("Flawless_gem");
            var gem2:String;
            var parts:Array;
            conditions = new Array();
            var specs:Array = new Array();
            if (spec1 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec1);
            };
            if (spec2 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec2);
            };
            if (spec3 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec3);
            };
            if (spec4 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec4);
            };
            if (spec5 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec5);
            };
            if (spec6 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec6);
            };
            if (spec7 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec7);
            };
            if (spec8 != null)
            {
                specs.push(spec8);
            };
            var i:int;
            while (i < specs.length)
            {
                parts = specs[i].split(":");
                if (parts.length != 4)
                {
                    this.logCmdResponse(("Invalid autostar specification, expect start:end:gem:count, get " + specs[i]));
                    this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                };
                gem2 = parts[2].substr(0, 2);
                if (((!(gem2 == "fl")) && (!(gem2 == "de"))))
                {
                    this.logCmdResponse(((("Invalid gem type: " + tech) + ", must be delicate or flawless in ") + specs[i]));
                    this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                count = int(parts[3]);
                if (((count <= 0) || (count > 4)))
                {
                    this.logCmdResponse(((("Invalid gem count: " + tech) + ", must be between 1-4 in ") + specs[i]));
                    this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                conditions.push({
                    "start":int(parts[0]),
                    "end":int(parts[1]),
                    "itemId":((gem2 == "fl") ? flawlessId : delicateId),
                    "count":int(parts[3])
                });
                i = (i + 1);
            };
            busy = false;
            this.pleaseStop = false;
            starHandler = function (_arg_1:GemstoneRespone):void
            {
                busy = false;
                if (_arg_1.ok != 1)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    logCmdResponse(("  autostar error: " + _arg_1.errorMsg));
                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                var _local_2:String = ((currentLevel > _arg_1.enhancedstarlv) ? "down to" : ((currentLevel < _arg_1.enhancedstarlv) ? "UP TO" : "at"));
                onCmdResult(((((((((("  star level of " + tech) + " is ") + _local_2) + " ") + _arg_1.enhancedstarlv) + ", gems: ") + getItemCount(delicateId)) + " / ") + getItemCount(flawlessId)));
                currentLevel = _arg_1.enhancedstarlv;
                cityManager._handleStarLevelResponse(_arg_1);
                timer.start();
            };
            handler = function (_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
            {
                var _local_2:Object;
                if (pleaseStop)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    onCmdResult("autostar has been terminated");
                    return;
                };
                timer.reset();
                if (busy)
                {
                    return;
                };
                if (((!(Connection.getInstance().authenticated)) || (Connection.getInstance().paused)))
                {
                    return;
                };
                if (currentLevel >= targetLevel)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    onCmdResult(("autostar is successful, star level is now " + currentLevel));
                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                for each (_local_2 in conditions)
                {
                    if ((((_local_2.start <= currentLevel) && (_local_2.end >= currentLevel)) && (getItemCount(_local_2.itemId) >= _local_2.count)))
                    {
                        onCmdResult(((((((("Autostar for " + tech) + ":") + currentLevel) + ", use ") + _local_2.count) + " ") + Items.getItemName(_local_2.itemId)));
                        ActionFactory.getInstance().getEquipmentCommands().EnhancedStarByGemStone(_local_2.itemId, _local_2.count, techId, internal::starHandler);
                        busy = true;
                        break;
                    };
                };
                if (!busy)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    onCmdResult(("autostar fails, current star level is " + currentLevel));
                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
            };
            timer = new Timer(100);
            timer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
            timer.start();
        }

        private function capitalPolicy(operation:String, fieldId:int):void
        {
            var capitalPolicyCallBackParams:Object;
            var fieldType:int;
            var getLeftPoliciesTimesHandler:Function;
            this.currentAction = "capitalpolicy";
            var op:String = operation.toLowerCase().substr(0, 2);
            if ((((((op == "ar") || (op == "di")) || (op == "po")) || (op == "fo")) || (op == "ta")))
            {
                capitalPolicyCallBackParams = new Object();
                capitalPolicyCallBackParams.operation = operation.toLowerCase();
                switch (this.castle.powerlevel)
                {
                    case 4:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams = null;
                        this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError('This city is not an HC. The "capitalpolicy" command can only be used from a Historic City.', -9999));
                        return;
                    case 3:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies = 4;
                        break;
                    case 2:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies = 6;
                        break;
                    case 1:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies = 8;
                        break;
                    case 0:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies = 10;
                        break;
                    default:
                        capitalPolicyCallBackParams = null;
                        this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("City data incomplete. Cannot determine if city is an HC. Refresh or try again in a few minutes.", -9999));
                        return;
                };
                fieldType = Map.getType(fieldId, 60);
                if (fieldType != -1)
                {
                    if (((fieldType == FieldConstants.TYPE_CASTLE) || (fieldType == FieldConstants.TYPE_NPC)))
                    {
                        getLeftPoliciesTimesHandler = function (response:CapitalCommandResponse):void
                        {
                            if (response.ok != 1)
                            {
                                onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Error received: " + response.errorMsg), -9999));
                                return;
                            };
                            if (!(response.amount > 0))
                            {
                                onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError((("You have 0/" + capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies) + ' policies left for today. Capital policy operation has been cancelled because "no policies remaining"'), -9999));
                                return;
                            };
                            var capitalCommandHandler:Function = function (_arg_1:CapitalCommandResponse):void
                            {
                                if (_arg_1.ok != 1)
                                {
                                    onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError((("Error received: " + _arg_1.errorMsg) + ((_arg_1.errorMsg.toLowerCase().search("policy decree used") == -1) ? "" : (((("  [ " + (capitalPolicyCallBackParams.leftPolicies - 1)) + "/") + capitalPolicyCallBackParams.maxPolicies) + " policies left ]"))), -9999));

        private function calibrate():void
        {
            var fieldId:int;
            var newArmy:NewArmyParam;
            var startTime:Number;
            this.currentAction = "calibrateCampTime";
            var newDate:Date = new Date();
            if ((newDate.getTime() - lastCalibrateTime) < 5000)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- please wait a few seconds between calls to calibrate", "#2A9A2A");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
            };
            this.onCmdResult(("Calibration at: " + Utils.getTimeStr(Utils.getServerTime())), "", "#2A9A2A");
            newDate = new Date();
            lastCalibrateTime = newDate.getTime();
            if (!this.isRallySlotAvailable())
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- No rally space available", "#2A9A2A");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            var targetId:int = -1;
            var cx:int = Map.getX(this.castle.fieldId);
            var cy:int = Map.getY(this.castle.fieldId);
            var r:int = 5;
            var y:int;
            var x:int = (cx - r);
            while (((targetId == -1) && (x <= (cx + r))))
            {
                y = (cy - r);
                while (((targetId == -1) && (y <= (cy + r))))
                {
                    fieldId = Map.getFieldId(x, y);
                    if (Map.getType(fieldId) == FieldConstants.TYPE_NPC)
                    {
                        targetId = fieldId;
                    };
                    y = (y + 1);
                };
                x = (x + 1);
            };
            if (targetId == -1)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- Please try again later, map is not yet available", "#2A9A2A");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            if (this.castle.troop.scouter == 0)
            {
                this.logCmdResponse(this.currentAction, "- need 1 scout to calibrate", "#2A9A2A");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            newArmy = new NewArmyParam();
            newArmy.missionType = ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SCOUT;
            newArmy.targetPoint = targetId;
            newArmy.troops = new TroopBean();
            newArmy.troops.scouter = 1;
            newArmy.resource = new ResourceBean();
            Utils._fa102(900);
            startTime = Utils.getServerTime();
            var handler:Function = function (_arg_1:CommandResponse):void
            {
                var _local_3:ArmyBean;
                var _local_2:ArmyBean;
                for each (_local_3 in cityManager._getSelfArmies())
                {
                    if ((((_local_3.missionType == newArmy.missionType) && (_local_3.targetFieldId == newArmy.targetPoint)) && (_local_3.troop.scouter == "1")))
                    {
                        _local_2 = _local_3;
                        break;
                    };
                };
                if (_local_2 != null)
                {
                    campTimeDelta = (_local_3.startTime - startTime);
                    CityStateCommands.callBackArmy(castleId, _local_2.armyId);
                    onCmdResult(currentAction, (("- estimated sending lag time is " + Math.round(campTimeDelta)) + "ms"), "#2A9A2A");
                }
                else
                {
                    logCmdResponse(currentAction, "- unable to calibrate", "#2A9A2A");
                };
                Utils.callLater(1500, onCmdFinshed, [true]);
            };
            CityStateCommands.newArmy(this.castleId, newArmy, handler);
        }
