        private function useHeroItem(hero:String, itemName:String):void
        {
            var h:HeroBean;
            var getHero:DisappearHeroBean;
            var onHeroListResponse:Function;
            var onHeroRecoverResponse:Function;
            this.currentAction = "useheroitem";
            var itemId:String = Items.getItemId(itemName);
            if (itemId == null)
            {
                this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("Invalid item", -9999));
                return;
            };
            if (itemId != "player.item.stoneoffinding")
            {
                h = this.findHeroByName(hero);
                if (h == null)
                {
                    h = this.findHeroById(int(hero));
                };
                if (h == null)
                {
                    this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("No hero found with Name/ID: " + hero), -9999));
                    return;
                };
                ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().useItem(this.castleId, h.id, itemId, this.handleCmdResponse);
            }
            else
            {
                if (this.cityManager.getBuildingLevel(BuildingConstants.TYPE_HEROS_MANSION) <= (this.cityManager.heroes.length - ((Utils.isRoyalFound(this.cityManager.heroes)) ? 1 : 0)))
                {
                    this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("No available space in Feasting Hall", -9999));
                }
                else
                {
                    getHero = null;
                    onHeroListResponse = function (_arg_1:DisappearHeroResponse):void
                    {
                        var _local_2:DisappearHeroBean;
                        var _local_3:String;
                        if (_arg_1.ok != CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
                        {
                            onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Error getting recoverable hero list: " + _arg_1.errorMsg), -9999));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (((_arg_1.herosArray == null) || (_arg_1.herosArray.length <= 0)))
                            {
                                onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("There are no recoverable heroes at this time", -9999));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                for each (_local_2 in _arg_1.herosArray)
                                {
                                    if (((_local_2.name == hero) || (_local_2.id == hero)))
                                    {
                                        getHero = _local_2;
                                        break;
                                    };
                                };
                                if (getHero != null)
                                {
                                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().RecoverDisappearHero(castleId, getHero.id, onHeroRecoverResponse);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    _local_3 = "";
                                    for each (_local_2 in _arg_1.herosArray)
                                    {
                                        _local_3 = (_local_3 + (((((((((((("\n[" + _local_2.id) + "] ") + _local_2.name) + "(") + _local_2.level) + ")") + " ") + _local_2.management) + "/") + _local_2.power) + "/") + _local_2.stratagem));
                                    };
                                    onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(((("No recoverable hero found with Name/ID: " + hero) + "\nTry copying the ID from the following list:") + _local_3), -9999));
                                };
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    onHeroRecoverResponse = function (_arg_1:CommandResponse):void
                    {
                        if (_arg_1.ok != CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
                        {
                            onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(((("Error recovering hero with ID: " + getHero.id) + ",") + _arg_1.errorMsg), -9999));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            onCmdResult("Item used successfully.");
                            handleCmdResponse(_arg_1);
                        };
                    };
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getHeroCommand().GetDisappearHeros(onHeroListResponse);
                };
            };
        }

        {

            zInd = ["fri", "sax", "nm", "boh", "ll", "fra", "thu", "mor", "ul", "swa", "bav", "car", "bur", "lom", "tus", "rom"].indexOf(abbr);
            if (zInd == -1)
            {

            };
            if (zInd == -1)
            {
                if (zone.toLowerCase() != "all")
                {
                    this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError((("Invalid state: " + zone) + ', consider using the first 3 letters of the desired state instead, or use "all" or leave blank for the entire map'), -9999));
                    return;
                };
            }
            else
            {
                x = zonesCorners[zInd].x;
                y = zonesCorners[zInd].y;
                endX = (x + 199);
                endY = (y + 199);
            };
            this.onCmdResult("Start deleting old map data...");
            if (zone.toLowerCase() == "all")
            {

                };

                        };
                    };

                    };
                };
                if (reqBuffer.length > 0)
                {
                    waitCount++;
                };
                if (waitCount >= ((speedFactor < 4) ? 6 : ((speedFactor < 7) ? 4 : 3)))
                {
                    waitCount = 0;

                    {

                };
            };

        private function colony(operation:String, fieldId:int, tr:TroopBean=null):void
        {
            var selectType:String;
            var levyType:String;
            var endStr:String;
            this.currentAction = "colony";
            var cB:ColonyBean = this.cityManager.getColony(fieldId);
            if (cB == null)
            {
                this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Invalid colony at " + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)), -9999));
                return;
            };
            var handleColonyLevyResponse:Function = function (_arg_1:ColonyLevyeRespone):void
            {
                if (_arg_1.ok != CommandResponse.OK_DEFAULT)
                {
                    onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Error received: " + _arg_1.errorMsg), -9999));
                    return;
                };
                var _local_2:* = "";
                if (selectType == "resource")
                {
                    _local_2 = ((_arg_1.amount + " amount of ") + levyType);
                }
                else
                {
                    if (selectType == "army")
                    {
                        _local_2 = ((((levyType + _arg_1.amount) + " ") + _arg_1.armyType) + endStr);
                    };
                };
                onCmdResult(("Colony levy response: " + _local_2));
                onCmdFinshed(true);
            };
            var op:String = operation.substr(0, 2);
            switch (op)
            {
                case "ab":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Begin abandon colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    this.setCmdResponse(ResponseDispatcher.COLONY_ABANDON_COLONY, this.handleCmdResponse);
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().abandonColony(this.castleId, cB.castleId);
                    return;
                case "fo":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Levy food from colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    selectType = "resource";
                    levyType = "Food Levied!";
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().levyFood(this.castleId, cB.castleId, handleColonyLevyResponse);
                    return;
                case "ta":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Tax gold from colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    selectType = "resource";
                    levyType = "Gold imposed!";
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().levyTaxes(this.castleId, cB.castleId, handleColonyLevyResponse);
                    return;
                case "ar":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Draft army from colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    selectType = "army";
                    levyType = "You have drafted ";
                    endStr = " from the city.";
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().levyArmy(this.castleId, cB.castleId, handleColonyLevyResponse);
                    return;
                case "po":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Redeploy population from " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    selectType = "resource";
                    levyType = "Population redeployed!";
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().levyPopulation(this.castleId, cB.castleId, handleColonyLevyResponse);
                    return;
                case "di":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Disarm " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    selectType = "army";
                    levyType = "You have disarmed ";
                    endStr = " in the city.";
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().reduceArmaments(this.castleId, cB.castleId, handleColonyLevyResponse);
                    return;
                case "ov":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Overview colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().overviewColonialCastle(this.castleId, cB.castleId, this.handleGetColonyOverviewResponse);
                    return;
                case "so":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Sow discord on colony " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    this.setCmdResponse(ResponseDispatcher.COLONY_SOW_DISCORD, this.handleCmdResponse);
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().sowDiscord(this.castleId, cB.castleId);
                    return;
                case "in":
                    this.onCmdResult((((((("Army info for " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName));
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getColonyCommands().getColonialArmyInfo(this.castleId, cB.castleId, this.handleGetColonyArmyInfoResponse);
                    return;
                case "su":
                    if (tr != null)
                    {
                        this.onCmdResult((((((((("Set suppression troop setting for " + cB.cityName) + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(fieldId)) + " by ") + cB.lordName) + " of ") + cB.allianceName) + " to ") + Utils.troopBeanToMsgString(tr, false)));

                    };
                    return;
                default:

        public function _doQuickMarch(marchType:int, targetId:int, hero:String, troopObj:TroopBean, resources:ResourceBean=null, restTime:String="", warEnsign:Boolean=false, stygandrsBannerOfTheHorde:Boolean=false, argGearing:int=0, callback:Function=null):String
        {
            if (targetId == this.castle.fieldId)
            {
                return ("Invalid target. Target is the current castle");
            };
            if (targetId == -1)
            {
                return ("Error: Invalid target coordinates.  Specify coords as 'x,y'");
            };
            if (!this.isRallySlotAvailable())
            {
                return ("Error: No rally space available");
            };
            var minStamina:int = ((marchType != ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SEND) ? ((marchType != ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_TRANS) ? 4 : 2) : 1);
            var selectedHero:HeroBean;
            try
            {
                if (((!(hero == "")) && (!(hero.toLowerCase() == "none"))))
                {
                    selectedHero = this.getHeroByNameOrKey(hero, minStamina);
                    if (selectedHero == null)
                    {
                        return ("Error: No idle hero available");
                    };
                };
            }
            catch(error:Error)
            {
                return ("Error: Invalid hero specified " + hero);
            };
            if ((((((!(marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SEND)) && (!(marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_TRANS))) && (!(marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SCOUT))) && (!(marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_CONSTRUCT))) && (selectedHero == null)))
            {
                return ("Error: a hero is required for this mission");
            };
            if (!this.cityHasEnoughTroops(troopObj))
            {
                return ("Error: Not enough troop");
            };
            var newArmy:NewArmyParam = new NewArmyParam();
            newArmy.missionType = marchType;
            newArmy.targetPoint = targetId;
            newArmy.troops = troopObj;
            newArmy.useFlag = warEnsign;
            newArmy.useItem = stygandrsBannerOfTheHorde;
            newArmy.resource = ((resources != null) ? resources : new ResourceBean());
            if (selectedHero != null)
            {
                newArmy.heroId = selectedHero.id;
                if (((argGearing > 0) && (argGearing < 4)))
                {
                    ActionFactory.getInstance().getEquipmentCommands().WearAllEquipmenttech(selectedHero.id, argGearing);
                    this.onCmdResult((((" Changing gear to " + ((argGearing == 1) ? "Pol" : ((argGearing == 2) ? "Atk" : "Int"))) + " for ") + selectedHero.name));
                };
            };
            var baseTravelTime:Number = this.cityManager.getBaseTravelTime(this.castle.fieldId, targetId, troopObj);
            var rsSpeedUp:int = ((((!(MainScreen.getCityFromFieldId(targetId) == null)) || ((((Map.getType(targetId) == FieldConstants.TYPE_CASTLE) && (!(Map.getDetailInfo(targetId, 30).allianceName == null))) && (!(this.player.playerInfo.alliance == null))) && (Map.getDetailInfo(targetId, 30).allianceName == this.player.playerInfo.alliance))) && ((marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_SEND) || (marchType == ObjConstants.ARMY_MISSION_TRANS))) ? this._getReliefStationSpeedupFactor() : 1);
            var heroSpeedUp:Number = ((selectedHero != null) ? Utils.getHeroSpeedFactor(selectedHero) : 1);
            var travelTime:int = int(((baseTravelTime / rsSpeedUp) / heroSpeedUp));
            var buffsCampFactor:Number = 1;
            var restTimeNumeric:Number = 0;
            if (restTime != "")
            {
                buffsCampFactor = this.cityManager.getCampTimeChangeBuffsFactor();
                if (((travelTime == 0) && (buffsCampFactor == 1)))
                {
                    return ("ERROR: No troop or town has yet to be initialized (travel time or research not available yet");
                };
                if ((restTimeNumeric = this._parseRestTime(restTime, travelTime)) > 0)
                {
                    if (int((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor)) > ((24 * 60) * 60))
                    {
                        return (("Error: Camp time exceeds server limit at " + Utils.formatTime((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor))) + "! Example camp time limits: [normal 24h] [1xFF ~10h:8m:24s] [2xFF ~2h:9m:36s]");
                    };
                    if (restTimeNumeric > (20 * 3600))
                    {
                        return (("Error: Large camp time " + Utils.formatTime(restTimeNumeric)) + " is more than 20 hours");
                    };
                };
                if (restTimeNumeric < 0)
                {
                    return (((("Error: Bad camp time " + restTime) + ", resulting in negative camp time: ") + restTimeNumeric) + ", make sure you run 'calibrate' recently!");
                };
            };
            if (int((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor)) > ((24 * 60) * 60))
            {
                return (("Camp time exceeds server limit at " + Utils.formatTime((int(restTimeNumeric) * buffsCampFactor))) + "! Example camp time limits: [normal 24h] [1xFF ~10h:8m:24s] [2xFF ~2h:9m:36s]");
            };
            newArmy.restTime = int(restTimeNumeric);
            if (restTime != "")
            {
                Utils.callLater(((restTimeNumeric - newArmy.restTime) * 1000), CityStateCommands.newArmy, [this.castleId, newArmy, callback]);
            }
            else
            {
                CityStateCommands.newArmy(this.castleId, newArmy, callback);
            };
            return (((((((((("- Marching to " + Map.fieldIdToCoordString(targetId)) + " arrival at ") + Utils.getLogTimeStr(((Utils.getServerTime() + campTimeDelta) + ((travelTime + restTimeNumeric) * 1000)))) + ((selectedHero == null) ? "" : (" using " + selectedHero.name))) + " with ") + Utils.troopBeanToMsgString(troopObj)) + " carrying ") + Utils.resourceBeanToString(resources)) + " in ") + Utils.formatTime((travelTime + newArmy.restTime)));
        }

        public function getMapFieldList(name:String, lev:int, rad:Number, center:int=-1, rtnCoords:Boolean=true):String
        {
            var y:int;
            var i:int;
            if (center == -1)
            {
                center = this.castle.fieldId;
            };
            var type:int = Map.getFieldType(name);
            if (type == -1)
            {
                return (null);
            };
            if (((lev < 0) || (lev > 20)))
            {
                return (null);
            };
            if (rad < 0)
            {
                return (null);
            };
            var cX:int = Map.getX(center);
            var cY:int = Map.getY(center);
            if (!Map.isMapReady(cX, cY, rad))
            {
                return (null);
            };
            var fieldId:int;
            var fieldLvl:int;
            var fieldObj:MapCastleBean;
            var results:Array = new Array();
            var x:int = (cX - rad);
            while (x <= (cX + rad))
            {
                y = (cY - rad);
                while (y <= (cY + rad))
                {
                    if (!((((x - cX) * (x - cX)) + ((y - cY) * (y - cY))) > (rad * rad)))
                    {
                        fieldId = Map.getFieldId(x, y);
                        if (Map.getType(fieldId) == type)
                        {
                            fieldLvl = Map.getLevel(fieldId);
                            if ((((fieldLvl == 10) && (lev >= 10)) && ((type == FieldConstants.TYPE_NPC) || (type == FieldConstants.TYPE_CASTLE))))
                            {
                                if ((fieldObj = Map.getDetailInfo(fieldId)) != null)
                                {
                                    fieldLvl = (18 - (2 * fieldObj.powerLevel));
                                };
                            };
                            if ((((fieldLvl == lev) || (lev == 0)) && (results.indexOf(fieldId) == -1)))
                            {
                                results.push(fieldId);
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    y = (y + 1);
                };
                x = (x + 1);
            };
            if (results.length == 0)
            {
                return (null);
            };
            var sortOn:Function = function (_arg_1:int, _arg_2:int):int
            {
                var _local_3:Number = Map.fieldDistance(_arg_1, center);
                var _local_4:Number = Map.fieldDistance(_arg_2, center);
                return ((_local_3 < _local_4) ? -1 : ((_local_3 > _local_4) ? 1 : 0));
            };
            results.sort(sortOn);
            if (rtnCoords)
            {
                i = 0;
                while (i < results.length)
                {
                    results[i] = Map.fieldIdToCoordinate(results[i]);
                    i = (i + 1);
                };
            };
            return (results.join(" "));
        }

            {

        private function loginToSkype(un:String, pw:String):void
        {
            this.currentAction = "loggingIntoSkype";
            var handler:Function = function (_arg_1:SkypeResponse):void
            {
                if (_arg_1.ok != SkypeConstants.OK_DEFAULT)
                {
                    onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(_arg_1.errorMsg, _arg_1.ok));
                }
                else
                {
                    cityManager.logMsg("Skype login successful");
                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                };
            };
            var response:SkypeResponse = Skype.login(un, pw, handler);
            if (response.ok == SkypeConstants.OK_DEFAULT)
            {
                if (!this.script.silence)
                {
                    this.cityManager.logMsg(((("Attempting login to skype with username: " + un) + " and password: ") + pw));
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (response.ok == SkypeConstants.ERROR_USER_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN)
                {
                    if (!this.script.silence)
                    {
                        this.cityManager.logMsg(("Already logged into skype with username " + un));
                    };
                    this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                }
                else
                {
                    this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(response.errorMsg, response.ok));
                };
            };
        }

        private function skypePm(userid:String, msg:String):void
        {
            this.currentAction = "sendSkypePrivateMessage";
            var handler:Function = function (_arg_1:SkypeResponse):void
            {
                if (_arg_1.ok != SkypeConstants.OK_DEFAULT)
                {
                    if (currentAction == "sendSkypePrivateMessage")
                    {
                        onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(_arg_1.errorMsg, _arg_1.ok));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        cityManager.logMsg(((_arg_1.errorMsg + ":") + _arg_1.ok));
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!script.silence)
                    {
                        cityManager.logMsg(_arg_1.msg);
                    };
                    if (currentAction == "sendSkypePrivateMessage")
                    {
                        onCmdFinshed(true);
                    };
                };
            };
            var response:SkypeResponse = Skype.queueMsg(userid, msg, false, handler);
            if (response.ok != SkypeConstants.OK_DEFAULT)
            {
                if (response.ok == SkypeConstants.OK_MSG_QUEUED)
                {
                    this.cityManager.logMsg("Skype private message has been queued, waiting for login to send...");
                    this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                }
                else
                {
                    this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Error sending Skype Private Message: " + response.errorMsg), response.ok));
                };
            };
        }

        private function monitorPrestige(nick:String, popChecked:Boolean=false, maxResultCount:int=30):void
        {
            var lastPrest:int;
            var lastPopChange:int;
            var lastPop:int;
            var lastTime:Number;
            var date:Date;
            var result:Array;
            var callBack:Function;
            var handler:Function;
            var timer:Timer;
            this.currentAction = "monitorprestige";
            this.pleaseStop = false;
            lastPrest = -1;
            lastPopChange = -1;
            lastPop = -1;
            var counter:int;
            lastTime = -1;
            date = new Date();
            result = new Array();
            nick = nick.split("-").join(" ");
            callBack = function (_arg_1:PlayerInfoResponse):void
            {
                if (_arg_1.ok != 1)
                {

                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                if (_arg_1.playerInfo.userName.toLowerCase() != nick.toLowerCase())
                {
                    return;
                };
                if (lastPrest == -1)
                {
                    lastPrest = _arg_1.playerInfo.prestige;
                    lastPop = _arg_1.playerInfo.population;
                    if (lastPopChange == -1)
                    {
                        lastPopChange = (_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop);
                    };
                    lastTime = Utils.getServerTime();
                    date.setTime(lastTime);
                    cityManager.logMsg((((("Monitor player: <b>" + nick) + "</b>   starting Prestige: <b>") + lastPrest) + "</b>"));
                    return;
                };
                if (((_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige == lastPrest) && ((!(popChecked)) || (_arg_1.playerInfo.population == lastPop))))
                {
                    if ((Utils.getServerTime() - lastTime) > ((3 * 60) * 1000))
                    {
                        lastTime = Utils.getServerTime();
                        cityManager.logMsg(((((("Monitor player: <b>" + nick) + "</b>   last Prestige: <b>") + lastPrest) + "</b> ") + result.join("  |  ")), "#00CF00");
                    };
                    return;
                };
                if (((!((_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest) == 0)) || ((popChecked) && (!((_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop) == 0)))))
                {
                    if (popChecked)
                    {
                        result.unshift(((((((((("@" + date.getHours()) + ":") + Utils.format2(date.getMinutes())) + " ") + (((_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest) > 0) ? "+" : "")) + (_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest)) + ":") + (((_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop) > 0) ? "+" : "")) + (_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop)));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        result.unshift((((((("@" + date.getHours()) + ":") + Utils.format2(date.getMinutes())) + " ") + (((_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest) > 0) ? "+" : "")) + (_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest)));
                    };
                };
                var _local_2:int = (result.length - maxResultCount);
                if (_local_2 > 0)
                {
                    result.splice((result.length - _local_2), _local_2);
                };
                if (((!((_arg_1.playerInfo.prestige - lastPrest) == 0)) || ((popChecked) && (Math.abs((lastPopChange - (_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop))) > 1))))
                {
                    cityManager.logMsg(((((((("Monitor player: <b>" + nick) + "</b>  Change detected  Last pres: <b>") + lastPrest) + "</b>  Now pres: <b>") + _arg_1.playerInfo.prestige) + "</b>  New results: ") + result.join("  |  ")), "#EE0000");
                }
                else
                {
                    if ((Utils.getServerTime() - lastTime) > ((3 * 60) * 1000))
                    {
                        lastTime = Utils.getServerTime();
                        cityManager.logMsg(((((("Monitor player: <b>" + nick) + "</b>  No change  Pres: <b>") + lastPrest) + "</b>  Results: ") + result.join("  |  ")), "#00CF00");
                    };
                };
                lastPrest = _arg_1.playerInfo.prestige;
                lastPopChange = (_arg_1.playerInfo.population - lastPop);
                lastPop = _arg_1.playerInfo.population;
                lastTime = Utils.getServerTime();
                date.setTime(lastTime);
            };
            handler = function (_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
            {
                if (pleaseStop)
                {
                    timer.stop();
                    timer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    timer = null;
                    onCmdResult(((((("Done monitoring player: " + nick) + "   last Prestige: ") + lastPrest) + " ") + result.join("  |  ")), "", "#00CF00");
                    return;
                };
                timer.delay = (10000 + Utils.getRandomInt(0, 10000));
                if ((counter++ % 6) != 0)
                {
                    return;
                };
                if (!Connection.getInstance().authenticated)
                {
                    return;
                };
                ActionFactory.getInstance().getCommonCommands().getPlayerInfoByName(nick, callBack);
            };
            timer = new Timer(0);
            timer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
            timer.start();
        }

        private function attackWait(type:String="honor"):void
        {
            var handler:Function;
            var scanTimer:Timer;
            this.currentAction = "attackwait";
            this.pleaseStop = false;
            if ((((!(type == "honor")) && (!(type == "loyalty"))) && (!(type == "spam"))))
            {
                this.logCmdResponse("Invalid attackwait type, must be honor, loyalty, or spam");
                this.onCmdFinshed(true);
                return;
            };
            handler = function (_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
            {
                if (pleaseStop)
                {
                    scanTimer.stop();
                    scanTimer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                    scanTimer = null;
                    onCmdFinshed(true);
                    return;
                };
                scanTimer.delay = 2000;
                if (cityManager._is281(type))
                {
                    return;
                };
                scanTimer.stop();
                scanTimer.removeEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
                scanTimer = null;
                onCmdFinshed(true);
            };
            scanTimer = new Timer(0);
            scanTimer.addEventListener(TimerEvent.TIMER, handler);
            scanTimer.start();
        }

        private function updateBuildingBean(_arg_1:BuildingBean):void
        {
            var _local_2:String;
            for (_local_2 in this.castle.buildingsArray)
            {
                if (this.castle.buildingsArray[_local_2].positionId == _arg_1.positionId)
                {
                    if (_arg_1.level > 0)
                    {
                        this.castle.buildingsArray[_local_2] = _arg_1;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        this.castle.buildingsArray.removeItemAt(int(_local_2));
                    };
                    return;
                };
            };
            this.castle.buildingsArray.addItem(_arg_1);
        }

        private function onDoResearchResponse(_arg_1:AvailableResearchListResponse):void
        {
            var _local_10:AvailableResearchListBean;
            var _local_11:int;
            if (this.currentAction != "research")
            {
                return;
            };
            this.currentAction = "research_step2";
            if (_arg_1.ok != 1)
            {
                this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError(("Error executing research: " + _arg_1.errorMsg), _arg_1.ok));
                return;
            };
            var _local_2:int = -1;
            var _local_3:Number = -1;
            var _local_4:int = -1;
            var _local_5:Number = -1;
            var _local_6:int = -1;
            var _local_7:int = -1;
            var _local_8:int = -1;
            var _local_9:int = -1;
            for each (_local_10 in _arg_1.acailableResearchBeansArray)
            {
                if (((_local_10.upgradeing) && (_local_10.castleId == this.castleId)))
                {
                    this.currentResearch = _local_10;
                };
                if (this._ip715(_local_10, _arg_1))
                {
                    if (((_local_2 == -1) || (_local_3 > _local_10.conditionBean.time)))
                    {
                        _local_2 = _local_10.typeId;
                        _local_3 = _local_10.conditionBean.time;
                    };
                    if (((_local_4 == -1) || (_local_5 < _local_10.conditionBean.time)))
                    {
                        _local_4 = _local_10.typeId;
                        _local_5 = _local_10.conditionBean.time;
                    };
                    if (((_local_6 == -1) || (_local_7 < _local_10.conditionBean.gold)))
                    {
                        _local_6 = _local_10.typeId;
                        _local_7 = _local_10.conditionBean.gold;
                    };
                    if (((_local_8 == -1) || (_local_9 > _local_10.conditionBean.gold)))
                    {
                        _local_8 = _local_10.typeId;
                        _local_9 = _local_10.conditionBean.gold;
                    };
                };
            };
            _local_11 = -1;
            switch (this.researchType)
            {
                case "quickest":
                    _local_11 = _local_2;
                    break;
                case "slowest":
                    _local_11 = _local_4;
                    break;
                case "dearest":
                    _local_11 = _local_6;
                    break;
                case "cheapest":
                    _local_11 = _local_8;
                    break;
            };
            if (_local_11 == -1)
            {
                _local_11 = TechType.fromString(this.researchType);
            };
            if (_local_11 > 0)
            {
                CityStateCommands.research(this.castleId, _local_11);
                this.cityManager.updateResearch();
            }
            else
            {
                this.onCmdFinshed(new ScriptError("Unable to perform research.", -9999));
            };
        }

//com.evony.common.MouseManager

package com.evony.common
{
    import mx.managers.CursorManager;
    import flash.ui.Mouse;

    public class MouseManager 
    {

        internal static var isBusy:Boolean = false;

        {
            isBusy = false;
            isBusy = false;
        }


        public static function setNormal():void
        {
            if (isBusy)
            {
                try
                {
                    isBusy = false;
                    CursorManager.removeBusyCursor();
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                    Mouse.show();
                };
            };
        }

        public static function setBusy():void
        {
            if (!isBusy)
            {
                try
                {
                    isBusy = true;
                    CursorManager.setBusyCursor();
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                    Mouse.show();
                };
            };
        }


    }
}//package com.evony.common

        public static function getSkypeConversationId(_arg_1:String):String
        {

            {

                    };

                };
            };
            retrieveSkypeConversationIds();
            return (null);
        }

        private static function retrieveSkypeConversationIds():void
        {
            var http:HttpClient;
            var req:HttpRequest;
            var response:String;
            var handleHttpData:Function;
            var handleIdError:Function;
            var handleIds:Function;
            if (isRetrievingConversationIds)
            {
                return;
            };
            isRetrievingConversationIds = true;
            var count:int;
            var getSkypeConversationIds:Function = function ():void
            {
                http = new HttpClient();
                req = new Get();
                response = "";
                req.addHeader("Accept", "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8");
                req.addHeader("Accept-Encoding", "identity");
                req.addHeader("User-Agent", "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/57.0.2987.133 Safari/537.36");
                req.addHeader("RegistrationToken", ("registrationToken=" + regToken));
                http.listener.onComplete = handleIds;
                http.listener.onError = handleIdError;
                http.listener.onData = handleHttpData;
                http.request(new URI((msgsHost + "/ME/conversations?startTime=0&view=msnp24Equivalent&targetType=Passport|Skype|Lync|Thread|PSTN|Agent")), req);
            };
            handleHttpData = function (_arg_1:HttpDataEvent):void
            {
                response = (response + _arg_1.readUTFBytes());
            };
            handleIdError = function (_arg_1:ErrorEvent):void
            {
                http.listener.unregister();
                http = null;
                SkypeUtils.logErrMsg(" *** Error retrieving conversation ids ***");
                isRetrievingConversationIds = false;
            };
            handleIds = function (evt:HttpResponseEvent):void
            {
                var t:Object;
                var v:Object;
                http.listener.unregister();
                http = null;
                try
                {
                    t = com.adobe.serialization.json.JSON.decode(response);
                    for each (v in t["conversations"])
                    {
                        if (v.threadProperties != undefined)
                        {
                            if (conversationIds[v.threadProperties.topic] == undefined)
                            {
                                conversationIds[v.threadProperties.topic] = v.id;
                            };
                        };
                    };
                }
                catch(e:Error)
                {
                    SkypeUtils.logErrMsg(" *** Error retrieving conversation ids ***");
                    isRetrievingConversationIds = false;
                    return;
                };
                if (++count >= 20)
                {
                    isRetrievingConversationIds = false;
                    lastUpdatedConversationIds = new Date().getTime();
                    return;
                };
                getSkypeConversationIds();
            };
            (getSkypeConversationIds());
        }

        protected function makeRows(contentHolder:ListBaseContentHolder, left:Number, top:Number, right:Number, bottom:Number, firstCol:int, firstRow:int, byCount:Boolean=false, rowsNeeded:uint=0, alwaysCleanup:Boolean=false):Point
        {
            var xx:Number;
            var yy:Number;
            var hh:Number;
            var i:int;
            var j:int;
            var n:int;
            var item:IListItemRenderer;
            var data:Object;
            var uid:String;
            var bSelected:Boolean;

            };

                if (((iterator) && (more)))
                {
                    try

                        more = iterator.moveNext();

                        e.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));

        protected function scrollVertically(pos:int, deltaPos:int, scrollUp:Boolean):void
        {

            var j:int;

            var curY:Number;
            var cursorPos:CursorBookmark;
            var discardRows:int;
            var desiredoffscreenExtraRowsTop:int;
            var newoffscreenExtraRowsTop:int;
            var offscreenExtraRowsBottomToMake:int;
            var newTopOffset:Number;

            var modDeltaPos:int;
            var desiredPrefixItems:int;
            var actual:Point;
            var row:Array;

            var moveBlockDistance:Number = 0;

        protected function selectItem(item:IListItemRenderer, shiftKey:Boolean, ctrlKey:Boolean, transition:Boolean=true):Boolean
        {
            var placeHolder:CursorBookmark;
            var index:int;
            var numSelected:int;
            var curSelectionData:ListBaseSelectionData;
            var oldAnchorBookmark:CursorBookmark;
            var oldAnchorIndex:int;
            var incr:Boolean;
            if (((!(item)) || (!(isItemSelectable(item.data)))))
            {

            };

            {
                numSelected = 0;

                    if (curSelectionData != null)
                    {
                        numSelected = (numSelected + 1);
                        if (curSelectionData.nextSelectionData)
                        {
                            numSelected = (numSelected + 1);
                        };
                    };
                };
                if (((ctrlKey) && (selectedData[uid])))
                {
                    selectionChange = true;
                    clearSelected(transition);
                }
                else
                {
                    if ((((!(_selectedIndex == index)) || (bSelectedIndexChanged)) || ((allowMultipleSelection) && (!(numSelected == 1)))))
                    {
                        selectionChange = true;
                        clearSelected(transition);
                        insertSelectionDataBefore(uid, new ListBaseSelectionData(item.data, index, approximate), firstSelectionData);
                        drawItem(UIDToItemRenderer(uid), true, (uid == highlightUID), true, transition);
                        _selectedIndex = index;
                        _selectedItem = item.data;
                        iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.CURRENT, (_selectedIndex - indicesToIndex((verticalScrollPosition - offscreenExtraRowsTop), (horizontalScrollPosition - offscreenExtraColumnsLeft))));
                        caretIndex = _selectedIndex;
                        caretBookmark = iterator.bookmark;
                        anchorIndex = _selectedIndex;
                        anchorBookmark = iterator.bookmark;
                        iterator.seek(placeHolder, 0);
                    };
                };
            }
            else
            {
                if (((shiftKey) && (allowMultipleSelection)))
                {
                    if (anchorBookmark)
                    {
                        oldAnchorBookmark = anchorBookmark;
                        oldAnchorIndex = anchorIndex;
                        incr = (anchorIndex < index);
                        clearSelected(false);
                        caretIndex = index;
                        caretBookmark = iterator.bookmark;

        protected function collectionChangeHandler(event:Event):void
        {
            var len:int;
            var index:int;
            var i:int;
            var data:ListBaseSelectionData;
            var p:String;
            var selectedUID:String;
            var ce:CollectionEvent;
            var emitEvent:Boolean;
            var oldUID:String;
            var sd:ListBaseSelectionData;
            var requiresValueCommit:Boolean;
            var firstUID:String;
            var uid:String;
            var deletedItems:Array;
            var fakeRemove:CollectionEvent;
            if ((event is CollectionEvent))
            {
                ce = CollectionEvent(event);
                if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.ADD)
                {
                    prepareDataEffect(ce);
                    if (((ce.location == 0) && (verticalScrollPosition == 0)))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST);
                            if (!iteratorValid)
                            {
                                iteratorValid = true;
                                lastSeekPending = null;
                            };
                        }
                        catch(e:ItemPendingError)
                        {
                            lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(CursorBookmark.FIRST, 0);
                            e.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                            iteratorValid = false;
                        };
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (((listType == "vertical") && (verticalScrollPosition >= ce.location)))
                        {
                            super.verticalScrollPosition = (super.verticalScrollPosition + ce.items.length);
                        };
                    };
                    emitEvent = adjustAfterAdd(ce.items, ce.location);
                    if (emitEvent)
                    {
                        dispatchEvent(new FlexEvent(FlexEvent.VALUE_COMMIT));
                    };
                }
                else
                {
                    if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.REPLACE)
                    {
                        selectedUID = ((selectedItem) ? itemToUID(selectedItem) : null);
                        len = ce.items.length;
                        i = 0;
                        while (i < len)
                        {
                            oldUID = itemToUID(ce.items[i].oldValue);
                            sd = selectedData[oldUID];
                            if (sd)
                            {
                                sd.data = ce.items[i].newValue;
                                delete selectedData[oldUID];
                                selectedData[itemToUID(sd.data)] = sd;
                                if (selectedUID == oldUID)
                                {
                                    _selectedItem = sd.data;
                                    dispatchEvent(new FlexEvent(FlexEvent.VALUE_COMMIT));
                                };
                            };
                            i = (i + 1);
                        };
                        prepareDataEffect(ce);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.REMOVE)
                        {
                            prepareDataEffect(ce);
                            requiresValueCommit = false;
                            if (((listItems.length) && (listItems[0].length)))
                            {
                                firstUID = rowMap[listItems[0][0].name].uid;
                                selectedUID = ((selectedItem) ? itemToUID(selectedItem) : null);
                                i = 0;
                                while (i < ce.items.length)
                                {
                                    uid = itemToUID(ce.items[i]);
                                    if (((uid == firstUID) && (verticalScrollPosition == 0)))
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST);
                                            if (!iteratorValid)
                                            {
                                                iteratorValid = true;
                                                lastSeekPending = null;
                                            };
                                        }
                                        catch(e1:ItemPendingError)
                                        {
                                            lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(CursorBookmark.FIRST, 0);
                                            e1.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                                            iteratorValid = false;
                                        };
                                    };
                                    if (selectedData[uid])
                                    {
                                        removeSelectionData(uid);
                                    };
                                    if (selectedUID == uid)
                                    {
                                        _selectedItem = null;
                                        _selectedIndex = -1;
                                        requiresValueCommit = true;
                                    };
                                    removeIndicators(uid);
                                    i = (i + 1);
                                };
                                if (((listType == "vertical") && (verticalScrollPosition >= ce.location)))
                                {
                                    if (verticalScrollPosition > ce.location)
                                    {
                                        super.verticalScrollPosition = (verticalScrollPosition - Math.min(ce.items.length, (verticalScrollPosition - ce.location)));
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (verticalScrollPosition >= collection.length)
                                        {
                                            super.verticalScrollPosition = Math.max((collection.length - 1), 0);
                                        };
                                    };
                                    try
                                    {
                                        offscreenExtraRowsTop = Math.min(offscreenExtraRowsTop, verticalScrollPosition);
                                        index = scrollPositionToIndex(horizontalScrollPosition, (verticalScrollPosition - offscreenExtraRowsTop));
                                        iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST, index);
                                        if (!iteratorValid)
                                        {
                                            iteratorValid = true;
                                            lastSeekPending = null;
                                        };
                                    }
                                    catch(e2:ItemPendingError)
                                    {
                                        lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(CursorBookmark.FIRST, index);
                                        e2.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                                        iteratorValid = false;
                                    };
                                };
                                emitEvent = adjustAfterRemove(ce.items, ce.location, requiresValueCommit);
                                if (emitEvent)
                                {
                                    dispatchEvent(new FlexEvent(FlexEvent.VALUE_COMMIT));
                                };
                            };
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.MOVE)
                            {
                                if (ce.oldLocation < ce.location)
                                {
                                    for (p in selectedData)
                                    {
                                        data = selectedData[p];
                                        if (((data.index > ce.oldLocation) && (data.index < ce.location)))
                                        {
                                            data.index--;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            if (data.index == ce.oldLocation)
                                            {
                                                data.index = ce.location;
                                            };
                                        };
                                    };
                                    if (((_selectedIndex > ce.oldLocation) && (_selectedIndex < ce.location)))
                                    {
                                        _selectedIndex--;
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (_selectedIndex == ce.oldLocation)
                                        {
                                            _selectedIndex = ce.location;
                                        };
                                    };
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (ce.location < ce.oldLocation)
                                    {
                                        for (p in selectedData)
                                        {
                                            data = selectedData[p];
                                            if (((data.index > ce.location) && (data.index < ce.oldLocation)))
                                            {
                                                data.index++;
                                            }
                                            else
                                            {
                                                if (data.index == ce.oldLocation)
                                                {
                                                    data.index = ce.location;
                                                };
                                            };
                                        };
                                        if (((_selectedIndex > ce.location) && (_selectedIndex < ce.oldLocation)))
                                        {
                                            _selectedIndex++;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            if (_selectedIndex == ce.oldLocation)
                                            {
                                                _selectedIndex = ce.location;
                                            };
                                        };
                                    };
                                };
                                if (ce.oldLocation == verticalScrollPosition)
                                {
                                    if (ce.location > maxVerticalScrollPosition)
                                    {
                                        iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.CURRENT, (maxVerticalScrollPosition - ce.location));
                                    };
                                    super.verticalScrollPosition = Math.min(ce.location, maxVerticalScrollPosition);
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (((ce.location >= verticalScrollPosition) && (ce.oldLocation < verticalScrollPosition)))
                                    {
                                        seekNextSafely(iterator, verticalScrollPosition);
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (((ce.location <= verticalScrollPosition) && (ce.oldLocation > verticalScrollPosition)))
                                        {
                                            seekPreviousSafely(iterator, verticalScrollPosition);
                                        };
                                    };
                                };
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.REFRESH)
                                {
                                    if (anchorBookmark)
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            iterator.seek(anchorBookmark, 0);
                                            if (!iteratorValid)
                                            {
                                                iteratorValid = true;
                                                lastSeekPending = null;
                                            };
                                        }
                                        catch(e:ItemPendingError)
                                        {
                                            bSortItemPending = true;
                                            lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(anchorBookmark, 0);
                                            e.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                                            iteratorValid = false;
                                        }
                                        catch(cursorError:CursorError)
                                        {
                                            clearSelected();
                                        };
                                        adjustAfterSort();
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        try
                                        {
                                            index = scrollPositionToIndex(horizontalScrollPosition, verticalScrollPosition);
                                            iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST, index);
                                            if (!iteratorValid)
                                            {
                                                iteratorValid = true;
                                                lastSeekPending = null;
                                            };
                                        }
                                        catch(e:ItemPendingError)
                                        {
                                            bSortItemPending = true;
                                            lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(CursorBookmark.FIRST, index);
                                            e.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                                            iteratorValid = false;
                                        };
                                    };
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.RESET)
                                    {
                                        if (((collection.length == 0) || ((runningDataEffect) && (actualCollection.length == 0))))
                                        {
                                            deletedItems = reconstructDataFromListItems();
                                            if (deletedItems.length)
                                            {
                                                fakeRemove = new CollectionEvent(CollectionEvent.COLLECTION_CHANGE);
                                                fakeRemove.kind = CollectionEventKind.REMOVE;
                                                fakeRemove.items = deletedItems;
                                                fakeRemove.location = 0;
                                                prepareDataEffect(fakeRemove);
                                            };
                                        };
                                        try
                                        {
                                            iterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST);
                                            if (!iteratorValid)
                                            {
                                                iteratorValid = true;
                                                lastSeekPending = null;
                                            };
                                            collectionIterator.seek(CursorBookmark.FIRST);
                                        }
                                        catch(e:ItemPendingError)
                                        {
                                            lastSeekPending = new ListBaseSeekPending(CursorBookmark.FIRST, 0);
                                            e.addResponder(new ItemResponder(seekPendingResultHandler, seekPendingFailureHandler, lastSeekPending));
                                            iteratorValid = false;
                                        };
                                        if (((((bSelectedIndexChanged) || (bSelectedItemChanged)) || (bSelectedIndicesChanged)) || (bSelectedItemsChanged)))
                                        {
                                            bSelectionChanged = true;
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            commitSelectedIndex(-1);
                                        };
                                        if (isNaN(verticalScrollPositionPending))
                                        {
                                            verticalScrollPositionPending = 0;
                                            super.verticalScrollPosition = 0;
                                        };
                                        if (isNaN(horizontalScrollPositionPending))
                                        {
                                            horizontalScrollPositionPending = 0;
                                            super.horizontalScrollPosition = 0;
                                        };
                                        invalidateSize();
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        if (ce.kind == CollectionEventKind.UPDATE)
                                        {
                                            selectedUID = ((selectedItem) ? itemToUID(selectedItem) : null);
                                            len = ce.items.length;
                                            i = 0;
                                            while (i < len)
                                            {
                                                if (ce.items[i].property == "uid")
                                                {
                                                    oldUID = ce.items[i].oldValue;
                                                    sd = selectedData[oldUID];
                                                    if (sd)
                                                    {
                                                        sd.data = ce.items[i].target;
                                                        delete selectedData[oldUID];
                                                        selectedData[ce.items[i].newValue] = sd;
                                                        if (selectedUID == oldUID)
                                                        {
                                                            _selectedItem = sd.data;
                                                            dispatchEvent(new FlexEvent(FlexEvent.VALUE_COMMIT));
                                                        };
                                                    };
                                                };
                                                i = (i + 1);
                                            };
                                        };
                                    };
                                };
                            };
                        };
                    };
                };
            };
            itemsSizeChanged = true;

        private function doScaleContent():void
        {

            var interiorHeight:Number;

                    contentHolder.scaleY = scale;

                    contentHolder.scaleY = newYScale;
                };
                contentHolder.x = x;
                contentHolder.y = y;
            }
            else
            {

                contentHolder.y = 0;

                            };
                        };

                        contentHolder.height = h;
                    };

                        url = redirectedUrl;
                    };
                };
                _nc.connect(url);
            }
            catch(e:Error)
            {
                e.message = (e.message + (("  url: '" + url) + "'"));
                throw (e);
            };
        }

        protected function ioErrorHandler(_arg_1:IOErrorEvent):void
        {
            defaultErrorHandler("Channel.IO.Error", _arg_1);
        }

        protected function statusHandler(_arg_1:NetStatusEvent):void
        {
        }

        override protected function internalDisconnect(_arg_1:Boolean=false):void
        {
            super.internalDisconnect(_arg_1);
            shutdownNetConnection();
            disconnectSuccess(_arg_1);
        }

        override protected function connectTimeoutHandler(_arg_1:TimerEvent):void
        {
            shutdownNetConnection();
            super.connectTimeoutHandler(_arg_1);
        }

        public function get netConnection():NetConnection
        {
            return (_nc);
        }

        protected function shutdownNetConnection():void
        {
            _nc.removeEventListener(SecurityErrorEvent.SECURITY_ERROR, securityErrorHandler);
            _nc.removeEventListener(IOErrorEvent.IO_ERROR, ioErrorHandler);
            _nc.removeEventListener(NetStatusEvent.NET_STATUS, statusHandler);
            _nc.removeEventListener(AsyncErrorEvent.ASYNC_ERROR, asyncErrorHandler);
            _nc.close();
        }

        protected function asyncErrorHandler(_arg_1:AsyncErrorEvent):void
        {
            defaultErrorHandler("Channel.Async.Error", _arg_1);
        }


    }

class PollCommandMessageResponder extends MessageResponder 
{

    /*private*/ var _log:ILogger;
    /*private*/ var suppressHandlers:Boolean;
    /*private*/ var resourceManager:IResourceManager = ResourceManager.getInstance();

    public function PollCommandMessageResponder(_arg_1:MessageAgent, _arg_2:IMessage, _arg_3:PollingChannel, _arg_4:ILogger)
    {
        super(_arg_1, _arg_2, _arg_3);
        _log = _arg_4;
        _arg_3.addEventListener(PropertyChangeEvent.PROPERTY_CHANGE, channelPropertyChangeHandler);
    }

    /*private*/ function doPoll(_arg_1:int=0):void
    {
        var _local_2:PollingChannel = PollingChannel(channel);
        if (((_local_2.connected) && (_local_2._shouldPoll)))
        {
            if (_arg_1 == 0)
            {
                if (_local_2.internalPollingInterval == 0)
                {
                    _local_2.poll();
                }
                else
                {
                    if (!_local_2.timerRunning)
                    {
                        _local_2._timer.delay = _local_2._pollingInterval;
                        _local_2._timer.start();
                    };
                };
            }
            else
            {
                _local_2._timer.delay = _arg_1;
                _local_2._timer.start();
            };
        };
    }

    /*private*/ function channelPropertyChangeHandler(_arg_1:PropertyChangeEvent):void
    {
        if (((_arg_1.property == "connected") && (!(_arg_1.newValue))))
        {
            suppressHandlers = true;
        };
    }

    override protected function resultHandler(msg:IMessage):void
    {
        var messageList:Array;
        var message:IMessage;
        var mpiutil:MessagePerformanceUtils;
        var errMsg:ErrorMessage;
        var pollingChannel:PollingChannel = (channel as PollingChannel);
        if (suppressHandlers)
        {
            if (Log.isDebug())
            {
                _log.debug("'{0}' channel ignoring response for poll request preceeding most recent disconnect.\n", channel.id);
            };
            doPoll();
            return;
        };
        if ((msg is CommandMessage))
        {
            pollingChannel.pollOutstanding = false;
            if (msg.headers[CommandMessage.NO_OP_POLL_HEADER] == true)
            {
                return;
            };
            if (msg.body != null)
            {
                messageList = (msg.body as Array);
                for each (message in messageList)
                {
                    if (Log.isDebug())
                    {
                        _log.debug("'{0}' channel got message\n{1}\n", channel.id, message.toString());
                        if (channel.mpiEnabled)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                mpiutil = new MessagePerformanceUtils(message);
                                _log.debug(mpiutil.prettyPrint());
                            }
                            catch(e:Error)
                            {
                                _log.debug(("Could not get message performance information for: " + msg.toString()));
                            };
                        };
                    };
                    channel.dispatchEvent(MessageEvent.createEvent(MessageEvent.MESSAGE, message));
                };
            };
        }
        else
        {
            if ((msg is AcknowledgeMessage))
            {
                pollingChannel.pollOutstanding = false;
            }
            else
            {
                errMsg = new ErrorMessage();
                errMsg.faultDetail = resourceManager.getString("messaging", "receivedNull");
                status(errMsg);
                return;
            };
        };
        if (msg.headers[CommandMessage.POLL_WAIT_HEADER] != null)
        {
            doPoll(msg.headers[CommandMessage.POLL_WAIT_HEADER]);
        }
        else
        {
            doPoll();
        };
    }

    override protected function statusHandler(_arg_1:IMessage):void
    {
        if (suppressHandlers)
        {
            if (Log.isDebug())
            {
                _log.debug("'{0}' channel ignoring response for poll request preceeding most recent disconnect.\n", channel.id);
            };
            return;
        };
        var _local_2:PollingChannel = PollingChannel(channel);
        _local_2.stopPolling();
        var _local_3:ErrorMessage = (_arg_1 as ErrorMessage);
        var _local_4:String = ((_local_3 != null) ? _local_3.faultDetail : "");
        var _local_5:ChannelFaultEvent = ChannelFaultEvent.createEvent(_local_2, false, "Channel.Polling.Error", "error", _local_4);
        _local_5.rootCause = _arg_1;
        _local_2.dispatchEvent(_local_5);
        if (((!(_local_3 == null)) && (_local_3.faultCode == "Server.PollNotSupported")))
        {
            _local_2.pollFailed(true);
        }
        else
        {
            _local_2.pollFailed(false);
        };
    }


}

package mx.messaging.messages
{
    public class MessagePerformanceUtils 
    {

        public static const MPI_HEADER_IN:String = "DSMPII";
        public static const MPI_HEADER_OUT:String = "DSMPIO";
        public static const MPI_HEADER_PUSH:String = "DSMPIP";

        public var mpii:MessagePerformanceInfo;
        public var mpio:MessagePerformanceInfo;
        public var mpip:MessagePerformanceInfo;

        public function MessagePerformanceUtils(_arg_1:Object):void
        {
            this.mpii = (_arg_1.headers[MPI_HEADER_IN] as MessagePerformanceInfo);
            this.mpio = (_arg_1.headers[MPI_HEADER_OUT] as MessagePerformanceInfo);
            if (((mpio == null) || ((mpii == null) && (_arg_1.headers[MPI_HEADER_PUSH] == null))))
            {
                throw (new Error("Message is missing MPI headers.  Verify that all participants have it enabled."));
            };
            if (pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                this.mpip = (_arg_1.headers[MPI_HEADER_PUSH] as MessagePerformanceInfo);
            };
        }

        public function get serverPollDelay():Number
        {
            if (mpip == null)
            {
                return (0);
            };
            if (((mpip.serverPrePushTime == 0) || (mpio.sendTime == 0)))
            {
                return (0);
            };
            return (mpio.sendTime - mpip.serverPrePushTime);
        }

        public function get clientReceiveTime():Number
        {
            return (mpio.receiveTime);
        }

        public function get serverPrePushTime():Number
        {
            if (mpii == null)
            {
                return (0);
            };
            if (mpii.serverPrePushTime == 0)
            {
                return (serverProcessingTime);
            };
            return (mpii.serverPrePushTime - mpii.receiveTime);
        }

        public function get pushOneWayTime():Number
        {
            return (clientReceiveTime - serverSendTime);
        }

        public function prettyPrint():String
        {
            var _local_1:String = new String("");
            if (messageSize != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Original message size(B): " + messageSize) + "\n"));
            };
            if (responseMessageSize != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Response message size(B): " + responseMessageSize) + "\n"));
            };
            if (totalTime != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Total time (s): " + (totalTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (networkRTT != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Network Roundtrip time (s): " + (networkRTT / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (serverProcessingTime != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Server processing time (s): " + (serverProcessingTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (serverAdapterTime != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Server adapter time (s): " + (serverAdapterTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (serverNonAdapterTime != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Server non-adapter time (s): " + (serverNonAdapterTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (serverAdapterExternalTime != 0)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Server adapter external time (s): " + (serverAdapterExternalTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
            };
            if (pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                _local_1 = (_local_1 + "PUSHED MESSAGE INFORMATION:\n");
                if (totalPushTime != 0)
                {
                    _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Total push time (s): " + (totalPushTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
                };
                if (pushOneWayTime != 0)
                {
                    _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Push one way time (s): " + (pushOneWayTime / 1000)) + "\n"));
                };
                if (originatingMessageSize != 0)
                {
                    _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Originating Message size (B): " + originatingMessageSize) + "\n"));
                };
                if (serverPollDelay != 0)
                {
                    _local_1 = (_local_1 + (("Server poll delay (s): " + (serverPollDelay / 1000)) + "\n"));
                };
            };
            return (_local_1);
        }

        public function get serverSendTime():Number
        {
            return (mpio.sendTime);
        }

        public function get serverNonAdapterTime():Number
        {
            return (serverProcessingTime - serverAdapterTime);
        }

        public function get pushedMessageFlag():Boolean
        {
            return (mpio.pushedFlag);
        }

        public function get originatingMessageSentTime():Number
        {
            return (mpip.sendTime);
        }

        public function get serverProcessingTime():Number
        {
            if (pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                return (mpip.serverPrePushTime - mpip.receiveTime);
            };
            return (mpio.sendTime - mpii.receiveTime);
        }

        public function get serverAdapterExternalTime():Number
        {
            if (pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                if (mpip == null)
                {
                    return (0);
                };

            if (mpii == null)

                return (0);
            };

            {
                return (0);
            };

        }

        public function get responseMessageSize():int
        {
            return (mpio.messageSize);
        }

        public function get messageSize():int
        {
            if (mpii == null)
            {
                return (0);
            };
            return (mpii.messageSize);
        }

        public function get networkRTT():Number
        {
            if (!pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                return (totalTime - serverProcessingTime);
            };
            return (0);
        }

        public function get totalTime():Number
        {
            if (mpii == null)
            {
                return (0);
            };
            return (mpio.receiveTime - mpii.sendTime);
        }

        public function get totalPushTime():Number
        {
            return ((clientReceiveTime - originatingMessageSentTime) - pushedOverheadTime);
        }

        public function get serverAdapterTime():Number
        {
            if (pushedMessageFlag)
            {
                if (mpip == null)
                {
                    return (0);
                };
